label: Illustrative demo: Example Community Garden
description: A fictional neighbourhood garden page across four captures, written by hand to exercise the app before real recordings land.

source.attribution: Fictional page written for wayback-diff. Not a real archive capture.

blocks.t: A shared garden on Elm Street where neighbours grow vegetables, herbs and flowers together.
We have 24 raised beds. Ask at the shed on Saturday mornings to join the waiting list.
Leave a note in the box by the gate.
A shared garden on Elm Street where neighbours grow vegetables, herbs, flowers and friendships together.
We have 36 raised beds, including four wheelchair-accessible beds by the entrance.
Seed saving, first Saturday of each month
Email the volunteer coordinators at garden@example.org.
Return tools to the shed after use.
We have 36 raised beds, including four wheelchair-accessible beds. Plots are shared between two households to shorten the waiting list.
Borrow seeds in spring, return some of your harvest's seeds in autumn. The library lives in the green cabinet inside the shed.
The garden is where I met half my street. (A member since 2012)
Dogs are no longer allowed inside the growing area.
Email the volunteer coordinators at garden@example.org or join the monthly open meeting.
In 2023 we turned the old car park corner into a rain garden that soaks up storm water from the street.
